title: Eng hiring & onboarding weekly sync - 2026-03-10
content:
Attendees: Aisha (chair), Daniel, Miguel, Sophie, Rahul, Tom (hiring manager, remote), notes by Aisha

Quick context:
- Weekly cadence to cover interview debriefs, candidate pipeline, new hire onboarding tasks, and team health signals. Mostly working notes / action items.

Wins / updates:
- Offer accepted: Senior Infra Engineer (Leah Morris) accepted verbal offer on 2026-03-08, start date 2026-04-06. Onboarding plan drafted.
- Onboarding checklist v2 live on Confluence (link above). Feedback: add explicit SRE-runbook access step.
- Hiring pipeline looks healthy for infra track: 6 active screens, 3 on-site loops scheduled next week.

Interview debriefs (this week):
1) Candidate: "Backend - Payments" (referral)
   - Interviewers: Tom, Sophie, Miguel
   - Summary: Strong system design, good ownership examples, some gaps in large-scale migration experience
   - Score: 7/10
   - Rationale: Could ramp quickly; would be mid→senior depending on mentoring. Compensation expectation slightly above band (manager negotiating).
   - Decision: Proceed to manager sync; assign hiring packet prep (Daniel)

2) Candidate: "SRE - Observability"
   - Interviewers: Daniel, Rahul
   - Summary: Excellent Prometheus/Alerting knowledge, runbook-first mentality, experience with multi-region failovers.
   - Score: 9/10 (strong hire)
   - Decision: Extend offer draft. Discuss relocation stipend if needed. (Action: Daniel to draft offer by 2026-03-12)

3) Candidate: "ML Infra (Inference Runtime)"
   - Interviewers: Miguel, Sophie, Aisha
   - Summary: Good understanding of attention kernels and GPU memory trade-offs but limited hands-on with Triton/torch compile toolchain.
   - Score: 6/10
   - Decision: Keep in pipeline for associate role or IC2; ask for short take-home to evaluate kernel optimization skills. (Action: Miguel to send take-home by 2026-03-11)

Onboarding sync:
- New hire ledger: Leah Morris (Infra) start 2026-04-06; Mateo Alvarez (Platform Eng contractor) start 2026-03-16 (4-week contract).
- Buddy assignments: Leah -> Sophie; Mateo -> Rahul. Confirmed via Slack.
- Access blockers: Okta invite for Leah pending (People Ops to resend), GCP project access request created (G-12345) but missing billing role mapping. (Action: Aisha to follow up with IT by 2026-03-11)
- First-week plan: 1) security & tooling onboarding, 2) runtime walkthrough, 3) 1:1 with hiring manager + team lunch (virtual). Need PRs for first-tasks list (Sophie to prepare).

Team health / capacity:
- Signal: Several engineers report higher meeting load this sprint; feature work velocity slightly down.
- Miguel flagged burnout risk on infra team due to crunch for Dedicated launch (end-of-quarter). Suggested 2-week focus window and pausing non-critical meetings.
- Action: Tom to propose a focused 'no-meeting' block for Fridays next two weeks and circulate proposed priority list.

Open risks / blockers:
- Hiring velocity: offer counter on principal infra role (still negotiating), may need to reopen search if candidate declines. (Owner: Tom)
- Onboarding automation: still manual for role-based GCP IAM mappings. Longer-term ask to infra-automation team. (Owner: Aisha to write RFC by 2026-03-20)

Action items (owner / due):
- Daniel: Draft SRE offer (candidate Observability) — due 2026-03-12
- Miguel: Send take-home for ML Infra candidate — due 2026-03-11
- Sophie: Prepare first-week PR list & onboarding tasks for Leah — due 2026-03-25
- Aisha: Follow up with IT/People Ops on Okta & billing role mapping (G-12345) — due 2026-03-11
- Tom: Propose no-meeting Fridays and priority list to reduce burnout — due 2026-03-12
- RH/People Ops: Confirm relocation stipend policy to include in offers — requested by 2026-03-13

Notes to self / misc:
- Capture interview feedback patterns (common gaps around Triton/tooling) and add a screening question for inference runtime candidates. (Action: add to recruiting rubric)
- Add 'oncall overlap' note to new-hire schedule for SREs to ensure shadowing occurs before primary rota assignment.

Next sync: 2026-03-17 (same agenda + candidate pipeline update).

Raw/working notes: some shorthand during meeting — refer above sections for decisions.
